senses.gloss:
plāvinī
(‘that which makes one float and flow’)
------------------------------------------
The art and science of controlling the प्राण (vital air, life-force) is technically called प्राणायाम. कुम्भक is its third aspect where retention of breath is the most important function.
This कुम्भक is of nine types of which प्लाविनी is also one. In this, the belly is filled with the air that is circulating within the body, making the body light enough to float even on deep waters, like the leaf of a lotus.
Of course, the technique itself, mentioned in the works like the Haṭhayoga-pradīpikā (2.70), should be learnt and mastered from an expert in the field.
